description: Renovate (phase 11 M3, ADR-022): dependency update PRs. Dependabot stays on for ALERTS only (it does not support pnpm 12). Renovate does not read pnpm's minimumReleaseAge, so it is set here, above pnpm's 1-day default — never add a release-age exclusion without asking (CLAUDE.md).

packageRules.description: One weekly PR for everything that is not a major version (saves CI minutes).
Pinned on purpose (CLAUDE.md): Prisma 7.10 (8 only with a plan), ESLint 9 (eslint-config-next 15.5), Next 15.5 / React 19.1. Majors never proposed automatically.
Base images in the Dockerfiles and the CI services stay on Node 24 / Postgres 17 majors.

customManagers.description: Tool images run with `docker run image:tag@sha256:…` inside workflow steps (actionlint, zizmor, gitleaks).

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month
